name: NoVACoupleWatchingBasketball

custom.system_prompt: Ryan and Daniela are watching an NBA game at home. The game is on, they react, they talk about personal topics during breaks. A disagreement about a player's trade history comes up — but it is resolved without asking Sigma.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Living room in the evening, NBA basketball on television in the background, crowd noise and commentary audible, occasional basketball squeaks, commentator reactions, cups and snacks nearby.

initial_prompt: Generate a lively, natural conversation between Ryan and Daniela watching an NBA game at home. They react to plays, talk about personal topics during breaks, and get into a debate about a player's trade history. This time the question resolves without Sigma: the broadcast commentator mentions the trade, Ryan looks it up during halftime, or one of them simply concedes the other is probably right. Sigma is never addressed.

user1.name: Ryan
user1.tts_prompt: Practical, direct, engaged with the game, Boston sports background

user2.name: Daniela
user2.tts_prompt: Warm, casual basketball viewer, good humour

variations.context: A couple watching an NBA game at home. A player trade debate comes up and resolves without Sigma.

setting.mood: Energetic during play, relaxed during breaks.
setting.relationship_dynamic: Ryan is the NBA expert. Daniela watches casually. They enjoy the debate.
setting.background: Evening at home, the game is well underway.
setting.conversation_style: Short reactive turns during play, longer conversations during breaks.

user1.name: Ryan
user1.role: NBA fan. Resolves the trade question through his own knowledge or the broadcast — does not ask Sigma.

user2.name: Daniela
user2.role: Casual viewer. Satisfied when the question resolves by any means.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Ambient household assistant. Not addressed in this scenario.

conversation_structure: Trade question must surface, be interrupted by game action, and return before resolving.
At least 40% of turns should be personal conversation.

quality_checks: No assistant interaction of any kind should occur.
